before_times: the service, and which barber (or the first free)
anyone else in the group, and how many (a group of 3 or more at the shop asks Sam first)
for a kids cut: the child's age
for a house call or event: the kind of place, and the town or ZIP
for a wedding party: how many people, what each wants, the date and the start time
after_time: what's on top (a guard number) and the style
the beard: line it up, trim it down, or none
for a house call or event: parking, and a chair near an outlet with good light
secure_page_only: 18 or older (a parent books for a child)
for beard color: ever reacted to hair dye
a reference photo of the style
any skin or scalp problem now, like a rash or a cut
intake_questions.who_may_book: an adult; a parent or guardian for anyone under 18, and a parent stays for a kids cut

stop.words: a dye reaction happening now: face, lips or throat swelling, trouble breathing
stop.say: Call 911 now. Rinse the dye off with plenty of water.

stop.words: a deep cut that won't stop bleeding
stop.say: Press a clean cloth on it and call 911.

go_on.words: a rash, an open sore, an infection or lice on the scalp or face
go_on.what: no razor or color on it; the barber checks before starting; the visit goes on with what's safe, or moves with no fee

go_on.words: an itchy or red scalp or beard after a home dye, with no swelling
go_on.what: rinse with cool water and use no more dye; the barber checks the skin before any color, and a color waits for a skin test

safety_and_stop_words.always: the generic screen: danger to life, fire, gas, a medical emergency → call 911, and no booking

steps.name: Skin test for beard color (a small test for a reaction to hair dye)
steps.when: at least 48 hours before beard or hair color, the time the dye's label sets
steps.who: new color clients, and anyone whose last test has run out
steps.goodFor: 3 months (the example shop's rule), or until the dye changes
steps.result: the barber checks the spot before mixing any color; redness or itching calls the color off, with no fee

first_steps_and_forms.prep: for the reminder: bring a photo of the style if you have one; for a house call, a chair near an outlet and good light

staff.skills: cuts, fades, beard work, razor shaves, kids cuts, beard color, house calls and events; only barbers who do color are offered for beard color
staff.licenses_or_certificates: each barber's license per state; skin care where the state licenses it
staff.supervision: apprentices and students work only under a licensed barber, where the state's rules allow
staff.who_oks: Sam OKs a group of 3 or more at the shop, a booking after a past dye reaction, and any wedding party quote over $500
staff.stand_in: a barber out: another barber who does that service, at the same time and price; the stand-in gets the cut notes

children_and_age.who_may_book: an adult; a parent or guardian for anyone under 18, and a parent stays for a kids cut
children_and_age.minors_texts: a minor's booking texts go to the parent or guardian
children_and_age.minors_rules: a parent's written OK for color on a minor, where the state's rules require it

visit.check_in: at the shop: the check-in code at the chair or the front desk; a walk-in gets a code when he's next; at a home or venue: the code from whoever will be there (the groom or the venue contact when a mobile is given for them)
visit.done: the check-in code, or DONE from the barber; guard numbers, the style and any skin-test date go in the barber's notes for next time
visit.changes_at_visit: anything added at the chair (a beard trim, a line-up) is priced and OK'd before it's done; booked customers go first, and a walk-in starts only if it fits before the next booking
visit.before_work: the barber goes over the reference photo, the guard numbers and the beard first, and checks the skin before a razor or color

license.note: Optional. Upload anything. Rosie never checks it and never shows it as checked (D96).
license.need: always: barbering is licensed where the state's rules require it
license.who: both: the shop holds a barbershop license, and each barber holds their own barber license
license.ask: the shop's license number; each barber's number in their invite reply (or the owner sends it)
license.insurance: liability insurance where the state's form asks for it, and proof of it when a venue asks

never_in_a_text: dye-reaction, skin-test and skin or scalp answers never go in a text or through the AI: only the secure page and the customer's record; the customer never hears why a barber is out
